name: sg_cccs_cases_search
description: Search the Singapore Competition and Consumer Commission (CCCS) public register of cases against businesses: infringement decisions and penalties for price fixing, bid rigging and information exchange (agreements_collaborations), abuse of dominance investigations (dominance_conduct), consumer-protection actions on misleading practices and fake reviews (consumer_protection), and commitments accepted from firms (commitments_remedies). Each hit gives the case id, the firm or conduct in the title, category and a link. Filter by a word (a company, 'bid rigging', 'Grab') or by category. Merger reviews are not served; cases naming individuals are dropped and counted in individuals_dropped. Example: query="bid rigging". Use sg_cccs_case_get for status, reference, decision date and penalty.

query.description: Word in the case title or firm name (e.g. "bid rigging", "freight", "Agoda"). Optional.

category.description: Only this part of the register. Optional.

name: sg_cccs_case_get
description: Get one Singapore Competition and Consumer Commission (CCCS) register case against businesses by its id (such as agreements-and-collaborations/cccs-penalises-fresh-chicken-distributors-for-price-fixing-and-non-compete-agreements from sg_cccs_cases_search): the published title, status (for example Investigation, Closed - Infringement Decision Issued), CCCS reference, decision date, the case summary naming the firms and the penalties mentioned, and links to the decision and media release. An unknown id returns found:false; an entry naming an individual returns found:false with empty_reason not_a_firm_case. Example: id="agreements-and-collaborations/cccs-penalises-fresh-chicken-distributors-for-price-fixing-and-non-compete-agreements".

id.description: Case id as returned by sg_cccs_cases_search (category/slug).
